verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item mentions any admin data-export tool, compliance export, or bulk message-history export API for workspace/server admins; the evidence only covers bot/webhook/OAuth APIs, Nitro features, and unrelated community complaints. Discord's Gateway/REST APIs are for building bots, not for admin-initiated full history exports including private DMs, and users note messages 'disappear' without paid storage, further indicating no such export feature exists in the pack.
